+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Test chop_cells with position parameter to find character disappearing."""
+
+from rich.cells import chop_cells, cell_len
+
+# Scenario: We have "abc" followed by "わさび" on the same line
+# with width=5
+# "abc" = 3 cells, so position=3
+# "わさび" = 6 cells
+# First "わ" (2 cells) would make total 3+2=5, which fits
+# But let's test position=4, width=5
+
+print("Test 1: position=4, width=5, text='わさび'")
+text = "わさび"
+result = chop_cells(text, max_size=5, position=4)
+print(f"chop_cells('{text}', max_size=5, position=4)")
+print(f"Result: {result}")
+for i, line in enumerate(result):
+    print(f"  Line {i}: '{line}' (cell_len={cell_len(line)})")
+print(f"Note: position=4 + わ(2) = 6 > 5, so わ should go to next line")
+print(f"      But we get an empty first line!")
+print()
+
+# Let's trace through divide_line with a scenario that would use position
+print("Test 2: Let's look at a word that starts mid-line")
+# In divide_line, when processing words, chop_cells is called with position=0
+# So the position parameter might not be the issue
+
+# Let's test what happens with a word at the start
+print("Test 3: position=0, width=3, text='わさび'")
+text = "わさび"
+result = chop_cells(text, max_size=3, position=0)
+print(f"chop_cells('{text}', max_size=3, position=0)")
+print(f"Result: {result}")
+for i, line in enumerate(result):
+    print(f"  Line {i}: '{line}' (cell_len={cell_len(line)})")
+print()
+
+# Hmm, width=3 but first char needs 2 cells
+# This should still work since 2 < 3
+# Let's try width=1
+print("Test 4: position=0, width=1, text='わさび'")
+text = "わさび"
+result = chop_cells(text, max_size=1, position=0)
+print(f"chop_cells('{text}', max_size=1, position=0)")
+print(f"Result: {result}")
+for i, line in enumerate(result):
+    print(f"  Line {i}: '{line}' (cell_len={cell_len(line)})")
+print("This should still show all characters, just one per line")

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Test to reproduce the double-width character disappearing bug."""
+
+from rich._wrap import divide_line
+from rich.console import Console
+from io import StringIO
+
+# Test case 1: A line with double-width characters that need wrapping
+text1 = "わさび"  # 3 double-width chars = 6 cells total
+width = 4  # Can fit 2 double-width chars per line
+
+print("Test 1: Wrapping double-width characters")
+print(f"Text: '{text1}' (6 cells)")
+print(f"Width: {width}")
+divides = divide_line(text1, width, fold=True)
+print(f"Divides: {divides}")
+
+# Split based on divides
+if not divides:
+    lines = [text1]
+else:
+    lines = []
+    prev = 0
+    for div in divides:
+        lines.append(text1[prev:div])
+        prev = div
+    lines.append(text1[prev:])
+
+print(f"Lines: {lines}")
+for i, line in enumerate(lines):
+    print(f"  Line {i}: '{line}'")
+
+# Test with Console

+console = Console(width=4, file=StringIO(), legacy_windows=False)

+print("Console output:")
+print(repr(output))

+

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Test to reproduce the double-width character wrapping issue."""
+
+from rich.text import Text
+from rich.console import Console
+
+# Test case: CJK characters that are double-width
+# Each CJK character takes 2 cells
+# わ (wa) = 2 cells
+# さ (sa) = 2 cells  
+# び (bi) = 2 cells
+
+# Test 1: Width = 3 (odd number, would split within a character)
+print("Test 1: Width = 3")
+text = Text("わさび")  # 3 chars, 6 cells total
+console = Console(width=3)
+lines = text.wrap(console, 3)
+print(f"Expected: 3 lines with わ, さ, び")
+print(f"Got {len(lines._lines)} lines:")
+for i, line in enumerate(lines._lines):
+    print(f"  Line {i}: '{line}' (cell_len={line.cell_len})")
+
+# Test 2: Width = 5 (would split mid-character at position 5)  
+print("\nTest 2: Width = 5")
+text = Text("わさび")  # 3 chars, 6 cells total
+console = Console(width=5)
+lines = text.wrap(console, 5)
+print(f"Expected: 2 lines")
+print(f"Got {len(lines._lines)} lines:")
+for i, line in enumerate(lines._lines):
+    print(f"  Line {i}: '{line}' (cell_len={line.cell_len})")
+
+# Test 3: Test with mixed single and double-width
+print("\nTest 3: Width = 4, mixed characters")
+text = Text("aわb")  # a=1, わ=2, b=1 = 4 cells total
+console = Console(width=3)
+lines = text.wrap(console, 3)
+print(f"Expected: 2 lines")
+print(f"Got {len(lines._lines)} lines:")
+for i, line in enumerate(lines._lines):
+    print(f"  Line {i}: '{line}' (cell_len={line.cell_len})")
+
+# Test 4: Test when word is longer than width
+print("\nTest 4: Long word with double-width chars")
+text = Text("わさびわさび")  # 6 chars, 12 cells total
+console = Console(width=5)
+lines = text.wrap(console, 5)
+print(f"Expected: Multiple lines")
+print(f"Got {len(lines._lines)} lines:")
+for i, line in enumerate(lines._lines):
+    print(f"  Line {i}: '{line}' (cell_len={line.cell_len})")
